keyword: how to watch oscars on hulu

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards are on March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sunday, March 15, 2026'; R3: 'Sunday, March 15, 2026'; R5: 'March 15, 2026'; R6: 'March 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the date as March 15, 2026 for the 98th Academy Awards.

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards can be streamed live on Hulu even with basic ad-supported plans.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'All Hulu subscribers will be able to stream the Oscars in real time right from the app, no matter which subscription you have'; R3: 'stream live on Hulu (even if you don't have the live TV plan!)'; R6: 'even for a basic, ad-supported subscription'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm live streaming on Hulu for all subscribers, including basic ad-supported plans.

verifications.claim: The ABC broadcast of the 98th Academy Awards is live on Hulu starting at 7 p.m. ET (4 p.m. PT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'streaming live on Hulu'; '7:00pm EDT / 4:00pm PDT'; R2: 'broadcast live on your local ABC affiliate'; '7 p.m. ET'; R3: 'air live on ABC'; '7 p.m. ET'; R5/R6/R7: confirm 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm ABC broadcast streams live on Hulu at the exact times specified.

verifications.claim: Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards begins at 3:30 p.m. ET on ABC/Hulu.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Red carpet coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu'; R7: 'preshow, "On the Red Carpet at the Oscars," at 3:30 p.m. ET'; but R1/R2/R3/R7: 'official red carpet' or 'preshow' at 6:30 p.m. ET
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on red carpet start time: some specify 3:30 p.m. ET for preshow/red carpet, others 6:30 p.m. ET for official coverage.

verifications.claim: The full 98th Academy Awards ceremony is available on-demand typically the morning after for all Hulu subscribers.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: R2 directly supports on-demand availability the morning after for all Hulu subscribers.
